name: Pierview
description: Pierview is an AI Search Operating system.  It helps you understand and improve your AI Search performance through robust AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) capabilities. This connection allows you to access your AI visibility data, citations, brand kit, and traffic directly from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pierview to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pierview to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pierview.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pierview MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pierview lists 19 MCP tools, including generate_report, get_ai_seo_audit_checks, get_brand_facts, get_brand_kit, get_brand_sentiment, get_citations_by_host, get_citations_by_page, get_competitor_facts, get_competitor_llm_breakdown, get_key_metrics, get_llm_referral_traffic, and get_missed_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pierview?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pierview in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Pierview requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pierview is developed by Pierview AI Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
